narrative: A dynamic week in technology sees significant venture capital pouring into AI and robotics, alongside growing geopolitical concerns over AI governance. Developers are embracing new tools for performance, while critical cloud infrastructure outages underscore the importance of reliability. Meanwhile, scientific missions continue to break new ground in space and environmental research.

highlights.title: SpaceX alum’s aviation startup, Reliable Robotics, lands $115M, topping $1B valuation
highlights.whyItMatters: Significant investment in autonomous aviation signals a maturing sector and increasing investor confidence in advanced robotics applications.

highlights.title: US orders federal agencies to remove China’s DeepSeek AI from their systems
highlights.whyItMatters: This highlights growing geopolitical concerns and national security implications influencing AI technology adoption within government infrastructure.

highlights.title: Adobe Lightroom mobile can now open closed eyes in photos with a simple tap
highlights.whyItMatters: Generative AI is increasingly integrated into mainstream consumer applications, offering advanced, user-friendly features like photo correction.

highlights.title: Introducing tsrs: a Port of TypeScript to Rust
highlights.whyItMatters: This development reflects a trend towards optimizing fundamental developer tools for performance and memory efficiency through languages like Rust.

highlights.title: Eka is worth $1.45B thanks to a physical AI model that has experts raving
highlights.whyItMatters: Substantial valuation indicates strong market confidence and breakthroughs in physical AI models for robotics, suggesting broader industrial applications.

highlights.title: Google cloud outage takes down banks
highlights.whyItMatters: A major cloud outage impacting critical financial services emphasizes the paramount need for robust and resilient cloud infrastructure.

highlights.title: DeepSeek just open-sourced its inference engine
highlights.whyItMatters: The release of an open-source AI inference engine can significantly boost innovation and accessibility within the AI developer community.

highlights.title: Japan launches mission to bring home a piece of the Martian moon Phobos
highlights.whyItMatters: This space mission underscores continued international scientific collaboration and ambitious goals in planetary exploration and sample return.
